info.title: Phase Mirror Invariant Consistency Oracle
info.description: High-integrity, safe-by-design governance gateway providing L0 sub-100ns invariant validation and distributed Λ-Archivum Merkle synchronization.

tools.name: validate_l0_invariants
tools.description: Executes immediate bitmask validation for schema integrity and permission bits over specific operational modes. Adheres strictly to ADR-005 Fail-Closed semantics.

event_type.description: The operational phase mode triggering this evaluation check.

tier.description: Governance tier enforcement level: tier1 (Authoritative Block), tier2 (Experimental Advisory Warning).

permission_bits.description: 32-bit bitfield mask representing the active permission configuration.

schema_signature.description: 32-bit bitfield signature of the incoming schema layout.

expected_schema.description: 32-bit baseline expectation mask required to satisfy compliance invariants.

tools.name: reconcile_merkle_sync
tools.description: Evaluates a remote node's Λ-Archivum snapshot against local state tracking matrices to identify distributed schema or lineage drift.

remote_root_hash.description: The calculated SHA-256 Merkle root hash received from the remote distributed actor node.

remote_leaves.description: A flat key-value map representing the remote snapshot's leaves (Proton ID mapping directly to State/Payload Hash pairs).

tools.name: get_governance_status
tools.description: Returns the current health of the governance floor, including compliance rate, policy version, and overall system state.

tools.name: triple_lock_verify
tools.description: Executes the full Triple-Lock verification sequence (Genius -> Guardian -> Examiner) for a mission plan.

plan.description: The draft mission plan to be verified.
